description: Judge every conversation of finished runs again with the judge, rules and do-not-flag rules as they are now, then sort their problems again (Rescore in Test Results). Nothing is sent to the agent: the conversations stay as they were, and each new verdict replaces the old one. Use it after changing what the judge checks, not after changing the agent (run the tests again for that, with restart_runs). Runs still working are skipped. Name the runs by number, or give a batch_id. Uses the judge's model.

batch.description: Or every run of one launch: the batch_id run_tests or run_suite returned.
batch.title: Batch

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
